$description: Cendrawasih UI system tokens: role defaults, spacing, shape, motion and type. Brand-neutral: a brand in tokens/brands/ supplies the palette roles listed in $extensions and may override any color here.

brandContract.primary: The brand's main color: the Day action fill, heroes, the primary tone. Must carry on-primary at 4.5:1.
brandContract.primary-hover: primary one step darker (or lighter on a dark primary): hover on primary fills.
brandContract.primary-pressed: One step past primary-hover: primary fills while pressed.
brandContract.on-primary: Text and icons on primary, primary-hover and primary-pressed (4.5:1+).
brandContract.secondary: Second brand color: big shapes, outlines, watermarks, filled bands.
brandContract.on-secondary: Text on secondary-strong (4.5:1+), and display text on secondary (3:1+).
brandContract.on-tertiary: Text on tertiary-strong (4.5:1+), and display text on tertiary (3:1+).
brandContract.spotlight: The one color that calls for attention: the spotlight button, the highlighted word, the selected wash, the Night action.
brandContract.on-spotlight: Text and icons on spotlight and its hover and pressed steps (4.5:1+).
brandContract.accent: Fifth brand color. A brand with fewer colors may repeat one, or use a tint of primary.
brandContract.on-accent: Text on accent-strong (4.5:1+), and display text on accent (3:1+).

primary-strong.$description: primary as a small fill that carries text: tags, avatars, icon tiles. Defaults to primary; a brand deepens it when on-primary needs more contrast.

secondary-strong.$description: secondary as a small fill that carries text: tags, avatars, icon tiles. Defaults to secondary; a brand deepens it when on-secondary needs more contrast.

tertiary-strong.$description: tertiary as a small fill that carries text: tags, avatars, icon tiles. Defaults to tertiary; a brand deepens it when on-tertiary needs more contrast.

spotlight-strong.$description: spotlight as a small fill that carries text: tags, avatars, icon tiles. Defaults to spotlight; a brand deepens it when on-spotlight needs more contrast.

accent-strong.$description: accent as a small fill that carries text: tags, avatars, icon tiles. Defaults to accent; a brand deepens it when on-accent needs more contrast.

danger-fill.$description: Fill of destructive buttons and alert badges. The same in both themes (6.2:1 with white).

on-danger.$description: Text and icons on danger-fill and its hover and pressed steps.

2.$description: Gap between a label and its input; icon to text in buttons.

3.$description: Gap between stacked buttons and between tags.

4.$description: Inner padding of compact cards and inputs; mobile side gutter minimum.

5.$description: Gap between cards in a grid.

6.$description: Card padding; the page gutter on desktop.

7.$description: Space between a section title and its content.

8.$description: Space between groups inside a section.

10.$description: Section padding on desktop: the Cendra rhythm is generous.

breakpoint.$description: Mobile first: each breakpoint is the min-width where its layout starts. Phone is everything below tablet.

tablet.$description: Tablets and small laptop windows. Two-up grids start here.

laptop.$description: Laptops. The app side nav appears; below this it is a top bar.

wide.$description: Large screens. Content stops growing at layout-max and centers.

layout.$description: The 12-column grid. Columns are fluid; gutters and margins step up at each breakpoint.

columns.$description: Columns at every breakpoint. Phones span 12 or 6; wider screens use 6, 4 or 3.

max.$description: Widest the content gets. Margins grow beyond it.

gutter-laptop.$description: Space between columns from laptop and wide.

margin-phone.$description: Space between content and the screen edge on phones.

margin-laptop.$description: Edge margin from laptop and wide.

size.$description: One density: every product uses these heights. There is no compact mode.

control-sm.$description: Small buttons, with a pointer only. Grows to size-touch on touch screens.

control.$description: Buttons, nav items and tabs: the default height of anything you press.

control-lg.$description: Large buttons in heroes and bands.

target.$description: Smallest hit area of anything clickable with a pointer (WCAG 2.2 target size).

touch.$description: Smallest hit area of anything tappable on a touch screen.

nib.$description: The sharp tip of the feather on tags, badges and counts.

quill.$description: The sharp pair of corners in the large plume shape; table cells and code.

sm.$description: Inputs and menu items; the round corners of the feather.

md.$description: Image tiles inside cards, notices, menus.

plume.$description: The rounded pair of corners in the plume shape: `border-radius: var(--radius-plume) var(--radius-quill)`. Featured cards, hero media, the Band's inner panel.

pill.$description: Buttons, tabs, nav items and avatars: everything you press.

accent.$description: Colored outlines on large boxes: stat tiles, toned cards, the outlined Band. Thicker than `stroke-bold` so the color reads.

bold.$description: Card, input and secondary button borders: Cendra draws with a 2px line.

watermark.$description: The oversized icon or logogram behind a large outlined box, drawn in a second plume color.

fast.$description: Press feedback: the pressed step of buttons, tabs and nav items. Also things leaving the screen.

base.$description: Color and border changes: hover, selected, focus on fields.

slow.$description: Things that move or appear: a linked card lifting, a menu or dialog opening. The longest anything takes.

out.$description: Quick start, soft landing. For everything that changes, moves or appears.

in.$description: Slow start, quick exit. Only for things leaving the screen, with duration-fast.

display-xl.$description: Hero headline, one per page. Steps down to `display` below tablet (600px).

display.$description: Section titles on marketing pages; hero on mobile.

headline.$description: Page titles inside products; section titles on mobile.

title.$description: Card titles, dialog titles, settings groups.

subtitle.$description: List item titles, table group headers, form section headings.

body-lg.$description: Intros under a headline; marketing body copy.

caption.$description: Timestamps, captions, footnotes. Never for instructions.

eyebrow.$description: Uppercase kicker above a section title. Write it in sentence case; the style sets the caps.

display.$description: Headings, buttons, labels, tags and numbers. A brand sets its own face.

text.$description: Running text. A brand sets its own face.
